import pandas as pd, re
df=pd.read_excel('field_visit_log.xlsx', header=4)
# normalize village
def norm(s):
    if pd.isna(s): return s
    s=str(s).strip()
    s=re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',s)
    return s.lower()
df['Village_norm']=df['Village'].apply(norm)
# deduplicate Visit ID keep first
df_unique=df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
# normalize follow-up
def norm_fu(s):
    if pd.isna(s): return ''
    return str(s).strip().lower()
df_unique['fu_norm']=df_unique['Follow-up Required'].apply(norm_fu)
total=len(df_unique)
yes=sum(df_unique['fu_norm']=='yes')
print('total',total,'yes',yes)
print('pct',yes/total*100)
\"
